correctness.rationale: Two-step return implies Laplacian(f_first+f_second)=0; connectivity forces common firing total, and primitive two period makes it one at every vertex. First-round firing subset S yields independent chip-count intervals of length cross-degree c_S(v), whose minimum total is 2m-c(S). Thus the state enumerator is sum over oriented cuts of z^(2m-c) product_v[c_S(v)]_z, and each cut yields a full integer interval [2m-c,2m+c-n]. A maximum cut has every vertex incident to its crossing edges, and its interval contains all others. End multiplicities, reciprocity and connected MAX-CUT reduction follow. Independent direct P3 and K3 dynamical simulations agree with cut polynomial.
